craft_notes: Sthāyin: scaling chant. Rows: scales ascend. Rejected: tabulating — killed: chant carries count. Read aloud: mounting count.

lines: Sixty days a finger — a year at each crossing;
in-out, twelve-year dawn; three hundred days a finger-and-fifth — a year
where once the bean was named — by count five years a crossing;
so in one out-in breath sixty-year dawn —
l4.sanskrit_cite: pratyaṅgulaṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ tithaya iti krameṇa saṃkrāntau varṣam ity anena krameṇa praveśanirgamayoḥ dvādaśābdodayaḥ pratyaṅgulaṃ tithīnāṃ śatatrayaṃ sapañcāṃśe 'ṅgule varṣaṃ yatra prāk caṣakam uktam iti gaṇanayā saṃkrāntau pañca varṣāṇi iti anayā paripāṭyā ekasmin prāṇanirgamapraveśakāle ṣaṣṭyabdodayaḥ atra ekaviṃśatisahasrāṇi ṣaṭ śatāni iti tithīnāṃ saṃkhyā
